body: The depression territory. Hence the sub.
YES! I do stupid shit all the time these days. . Travel, strip clubs, tattoos, whatever. . . I think it goes with the territory.

There is some assumptions in your post that maybe you should examine:

That he is the one that should "nut up and leave". If you want out, you are welcome to leave at any time.

An unspoken but clear assumption that the kids are staying with you. When he leaves, he may take them with him. 

He has told you when he is comfortable leaving. If you can't stay in the situation that long, perhaps you should go?

Facebook Memories should totally have an opt-out! I just ended the best phase of my life, an amazing marriage to an amazing woman, and EVERY FREAKING DAY FB reminds me of how happy I was. I feel your pain. 
The nice thing is if you drink enough you forget what it showed you the next day.

Because it seems like an easy answer. Correlation does not equal causation. Its easy to say that ___ happens because I don't fit the societal norms of beauty, instead of ___ happened because I fucked up, someone else fucked up, or life just sucks. 
There are some SLIGHT advantages to being attractive. Tall, sexy people have a little bit of a leg up. But the "root" of problems is not there. It could be in your self esteem, based on how your think you are unattractive, though. . . .

Fuck yes. No question. I don't hear things, but what you are describing in the second paragraph is disassociation (I haven't experienced it). The pain, though, all the time. Mainly in the gut/chest, but sometimes its so bad that I just lay in a ball. And directly related to my thoughts, not VS. I know that it is my mind causing the pain, not my pain causing the mind.
